Naturally, my dear Nate, it seems the poor man has chosen such a dramatic exit for his final performance.
Naturally, my dear Ash, one might hope that even a simple stove could possess a modicum of restraint.

Naturally, this damp soil is hardly conducive to any meaningful aesthetic contemplation.
Of course, the culmination of this barbaric enterprise is merely a puddle of unfortunate viscera upon the grass.
Naturally, this raw mutton tastes distinctly less refined than the delicacies I once had served. gossip
Naturally, this destruction of furnishings is quite beneath the dignity of a civilized gathering, my dear Rook.
Naturally, the sight of that wretched brute stumbling into the frost is hardly a spectacle worthy of my considerable talent.
Naturally, the ambiance has been thoroughly interrupted by six rather graceless intruders this morn.
Naturally, this bench has proven a rather acceptable surface for my newfound mastery of form, my dear Ash.
